prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create the final round-two Minecraft builder reference sheet refining reference image 2, with reference image 1 as the material and architectural mood board. Landscape 3:2, plain light ivory background, crisp vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 voxel blocks, skilled human builder quality, no people or animals. EXACTLY TWO VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE: LEFT straight-on orthographic EAST street-front elevation, entire 312-block length, north at left south at right; RIGHT elevated SOUTHWEST three-quarter view of the same entire building at the same blocks-to-image scale, showing downhill west levels, southern corner and roof taper. Both views fit fully within their panels; no cropped north tail. Small restrained title and labels, architecture dominates; warm dusk light within windows and stalls against plain background.

Preserve the successful red/white/green awnings, slender green posts, colorful produce and flower stalls, framed glowing windows and hero red PUBLIC MARKET CENTER sign from the references. Correct three shortcomings: make the narrow north craft arcade and actual stepped widening footprint unmistakable instead of a long uniform stone plinth; give the south main building two to three substantial upper storeys with varied real low shed roofs instead of repetitive tiny stair-step boxes; place the red sign and white/red clock together at the SOUTH high-z corner on a white structural frame facing southeast toward +x,+z, with MEET THE PRODUCER immediately beneath, and visible fish ice counters at the entrance.

Site coordinates local x 0..42, z 0..311, absolute x347..389 z174..485; north low z, south high z, east high x uphill Pike Place, west low x downhill Elliott Bay. Never rotate the building. Scale 1.4 blocks/metre. Roof main mass about y49, total sign below y82. EXACT occupied footprint on 7x7 grid, rows north to south: rows0–18 col4 only (x28..34); rows19–22 cols4–5; rows23–26 cols3–5; rows27–31 cols2–5; rows32–35 cols1–5; rows36–43 cols0–5; row44 cols1–5 clipped at z311. Thus maximum OCCUPIED width42 within a 43-wide plot, not a rectangular slab. Keep every eave, platform and stair inside occupied cells. Southern clipped row retreats at west. North 133 blocks is a truly narrow roofed craft arcade on posts with tables, not enclosed upper-storey apartments. Widen southward only on west side. Follow terrain: north occupied ground y16–18, southern east y19–23, southern west y3–10; build masonry down to these surfaces, no floating, no broad invented terrace outside footprint. Show two to three tiers of recessed Down Under windows on low west side with supporting piers and setbacks, rather than a single monotonous retaining wall. Site slice only, no surrounding streetscape or bay water.

Southern upper facade white painted masonry with calcite piers, deep multi-pane framed glass openings, projecting cornices, dark wood sills, authentic depth. Low pitched shed roofs with clear deepslate stair eaves and slab verges/ridges, limited sensible changes of roof height. Green posts carry continuous open east stalls. North craft tables distinguish that section from the south produce stalls. Pixel-built sign spells exactly PUBLIC / MARKET / CENTER in red, visible white support frame, red stained glass over glowstone for neon. Adjacent round pixel clock white face, red glowing perimeter, black hands, small PUBLIC MARKET label. Wooden MEET THE PRODUCER sign below. No additional giant signs.

Use only these exact vanilla palette ids and their legal forms: white_concrete, calcite; dark_oak_planks, dark_oak_stairs, dark_oak_slab, dark_oak_fence, dark_oak_trapdoor, dark_oak_sign; green_terracotta; deepslate_tiles, deepslate_tile_stairs, deepslate_tile_slab; glass_pane; red_concrete, red_stained_glass, glowstone; white_wool, green_wool, red_wool; stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall; lantern, chain, barrel, chest; melon, pumpkin; flower_pot with poppy, dandelion, cornflower, oxeye_daisy; blue_ice, snow_block, gray_concrete, orange_concrete; item_frame displaying cod and salmon; black_concrete clock hands. Show stalls with wooden crates made from trapdoors, flower pots, produce cubes and fish on ice. All roofs, windows and small details must look buildable from these cubic blocks, stairs, slabs, fences, walls and trapdoors. No smooth modeled objects, no modern materials, no invented block variants, no pale oak. Small dimension labels: 312 blocks N–S; plot 43 × 312; roof ≈ y49. Add small coordinate arrows identifying +x east uphill, +z south, -x west downhill. This is a readable final builder sheet, not a photographic scene.

roles.role: Wood trim, counters, tables and crates

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and saved without post-processing as concept-2.png.
Addressed the unclear taper and heavy base with a visibly narrow north tail and more articulated downhill piers; exact footprint compliance still requires block-level verification.
Addressed shallow upper massing with taller southern storeys, deeper window framing and stronger roof edges.
Strengthened the south-end landmark with larger red lettering, a white support frame, adjacent clock and fish counters beneath MEET THE PRODUCER.
Preserved warm lighting, striped awnings, green posts and colorful stalls.

Inspection limitations: the generator stacked the views instead of placing them side by side, retained only one clear downhill window tier, and did not visibly resolve the small PUBLIC MARKET clock label. Exact terrain heights, sign orientation and matching view scales remain unverified.
